description: This PHP source file manages option transfer configurations for a web interface, providing functions to set up dual select boxes with JavaScript event handling, for transferring options between lists. It includes functions to initialize and configure transfer settings and options, as well as placeholder configurations.

methods.name: opt_transf_cfg
methods.description: Configures the option transfer settings, including JS events and the lists of options on either side based on the provided right list.

methods.name: keywords_opt_transf_cfg
methods.description: Initializes an option transfer configuration with a predefined size, style, JS events, and settings for from/to select boxes, then calls opt_transf_cfg to apply the right list.

methods.name: opt_transf_empty_cfg
methods.description: Creates a default empty option transfer configuration with basic style, size, and JS event placeholders.

methods.name: item_opt_transf_cfg
methods.description: Configures an option transfer setup for item options, similar to keywords, with specific field names and style.
